svg.title: How CTK works: one goal, a task graph, a ready frontier, three workers, verification
svg.desc: An illustration, not a recording. One goal becomes eight vertical-slice tasks with real dependencies. Only ready tasks start. Three native teammates work at once; the CTK mod limits native teammate spawns to three, so a fourth ready task waits. The lead hands the next ready task to an idle teammate with a short handoff (task id, spec path, file scope, verification command). The final task runs the verification command and the lead reads the result.

g.text: Plan: cut vertical slices with real dependencies
The lead writes the tasks; Claude Code keeps the shared list.
Ready frontier: blocked tasks cannot be claimed
Only tasks with no open blockers are started.
The mod caps native teammate spawns, not ordinary subagents.
Handoff by pointers, not pasted context
The extra ready task waits. The lead reassigns an idle worker.
Done unblocks dependents; the lead hands work on
The lead or the teammate picks the next task; CTK does not.
The skill asks the lead to run the check and read the result first.
Guided by CTK skills, followed by the model
Enforced by the CTK mod, on teammate spawns
An illustration of the workflow, not a recording of a run.
